title: The Way We Live Now: 11-11-01; Lost and Found, a piece...
content: The Way We Live Now: 11-11-01; Lost and Found, a piece written by Colson Whitehead just a month after 9/11. “The New York City you live in is not my New York City; how could it be? This place multiplies when you’re not looking.”
author: Jason Kottke
